title: Rabbi Gamliel son of Rabbi Chanina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kohelet Rabbah 5:12, asking a question before Rabbi Muna; Hyman says it seems the reading should be Rabbi Gamliel son of R' Inina.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Midrash Rabbah TE Kohelet Rabbah 5:12 paragraph fully names Rabbi Gamliel son of Rabbi Chanina asking Rabbi Mona. Hyman’s Muna form and tentative it-seems/should-read Inina proposal remain his claims; the uncollated Inina title remains R'. The alternative patronym is not an admitted genealogy or a silent substitution.
